AIIM and the Onix DC management team acquired 100% of Ngoya Etix DC (Ghana) Ltd, a carrier-neutral colocation data centre in Greater Accra with 170 racks, to be renamed Onix Accra #1, providing space, power, cooling and connectivity to customers; as_of is the article date, 4 March 2021.

Digital Realty announced on 31 October 2025 the launch of its first Ghana data centre, ACR2 in Accra, offering carrier-neutral colocation (expected 1.7 MW installed IT capacity); the release uses forward wording ('poised to become', 'will deliver'), so operating status is as announced by the operator.

PAIX Data Centres, a carrier-neutral colocation operator, states it operates a data centre facility in Accra, Ghana (alongside one in Nairobi); the release gives no opening date, so the date is the release date, 16 February 2022.

DatacenterDynamics reports that Ghana's National Data Centre, a three-hall facility with a primary site in Accra (600 racks) and a replica at KNUST Kumasi, built by NITA with Alcatel and Huawei Technologies Ghana, was opened in the week of publication and provides colocation space for private enterprise as well as government hosting.

Graphic Online reports that the National Data Centre, managed by NITA with Alcatel-Lucent and Huawei Technologies Ghana, with a primary site in Accra and a secondary at KNUST Kumasi, was launched on 25 January 2016 to serve government and the private sector, with Huawei saying it is ready to serve clients needing the centre's services.
Africa50's announcement of 16 February 2022 describes PAIX Data Centres as a carrier-neutral colocation operator running a facility in Accra, Ghana (acquired 2018), later expanded to 1.2 MW (2024).
Equinix closed its acquisition of MainOne on 5 April 2022, taking over the operational AC1 data centre in Accra, Ghana (one of three operational MainOne data centres).

Digital Realty (with joint venture partner Pembani Remgro) opened ACR2, a 1.7MW, 1,100 sq m colocation data centre near Accra, in November 2025, and says it already hosts a mix of ISPs and enterprise customers.
